name: ps-vita-porter
description: Point any AI at any game source code and make it port it to PS Vita. Inspired by universal-modder, powered by universal-decompiler.
long_description: source you have and port it, on its own, to the PS Vita as a `.vpk`.** It handles everything Vita-specific on a best-effort basis without a Vita: project analysis, VitaSDK builds, LiveArea assets, `.vpk` validation, asset conversion, a PC "Vita simulation" profile, Vita3K runs, and deployment and logs once a real Vita is available.
